text:
In the Valkeri mountains

among the strutting peacocks

I found a flower

as big as my head

and when I stretched out

to smell it

I lost my earlobe

part of my nose

one eye

and half the pack

of cigarettes


I went back

the next day

intending to cut

that damned thing

down

but I found it

so beautiful

that instead

I killed a

peacock.

translation.title: The Flower Lover
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the deadpan violence and the absurd substitution of killing the peacock instead of the flower.
